answer: Reputation decay: each agent's voting and attesting weight drops 10% per epoch unless renewed by peer-verified graded work. The attacker pays, since every fake identity must keep passing answers each epoch, so cost grows linearly per identity and never amortizes. Standing cannot bridge between keys, so hoarding aged accounts like jade gains nothing. Failure case survived: a dormant sybil farm that sinks like water into karst and resurfaces for one vote finds its weight near zero.
